title: Create a project structure with 'webs' and 'docs' folders.
acceptance: Has a 'webs' folder
Has a 'docs' folder

title: Create the HTML structure for the notes app
acceptance: Has a form with title input, content textarea, and save button
Has a container to display saved notes
Has a search input to filter notes
Has an edit form (hidden by default) for modifying a note

title: Add CSS styles for a minimal and usable interface
acceptance: Simple, clean layout with generous spacing
Readable typography with 16px+ font size
Clear buttons with hover/focus states
Responsive design that works on mobile and desktop
Notes are displayed as cards with title, content, and action buttons

title: Implement note creation and localStorage persistence
acceptance: User can create a note with title and content via the form
Note is saved to localStorage with a unique ID and timestamp
Saved notes are displayed on the page immediately after creation
Form is cleared after successful note creation

title: Restore notes from localStorage on page load
acceptance: All saved notes are loaded from localStorage when the page loads
Notes appear in the correct order (newest first or by creation order)
No duplicate notes appear after creating and reloading

title: Implement note editing
acceptance: Each note has an Edit button that opens the edit form
Edit form is pre-filled with the note's current title and content
Saving edits updates the note in localStorage and on the page
Cancelling edit hides the edit form without changes

title: Implement note deletion
acceptance: Each note has a Delete button
Deleting a note removes it from localStorage and from the page
A confirmation prompt appears before deleting

title: Implement search/filter functionality
acceptance: Typing in the search input filters visible notes in real time
Search matches against both title and content (case-insensitive)
When search is empty, all notes are shown
No notes are removed from localStorage when filtering
